steps.command:
pwd
ls -la /workspace
echo "--- / ---"
ls -la /
echo "--- find git dirs ---"
find / -maxdepth 4 -name .git -type d 2>/dev/null | head -50
echo "--- find app ---"
ls -la /app 2>/dev/null

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "=== STATUS ==="
git status
echo "=== BRANCHES ==="
git branch -a -vv
echo "=== LOG ALL ==="
git log --oneline --all --decorate --graph -40
echo "=== STASH ==="
git stash list
echo "=== REFLOG ==="
git reflog --date=iso --all -40

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "=== COMMIT 650dba4 ==="
git show --stat --summary 650dba427e0a9dcd118f41a4c5e35c8017550a5a
echo
echo "=== PARENTS ==="
git rev-list --parents -n 1 650dba4
echo
echo "=== FULL DIFF vs parent ==="
git show --format=fuller 650dba4
echo
echo "=== master vs commit ==="
git log --oneline --left-right master...650dba4
echo
echo "=== files differing between master and 650dba4 ==="
git diff --stat master 650dba4

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "=== master commit d7d3e4b ==="
git show --format=fuller --stat d7d3e4b
echo
git show --format= --unified=3 d7d3e4b
echo "=== merge-base ==="
git merge-base master 650dba4
echo "=== test merge-tree (dry run) ==="
git merge-tree $(git merge-base master 650dba4) master 650dba4

cd /workspace/personal-site 2>/dev/null || true
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
git config user.name >/dev/null 2>&1 || git config user.name "Test User"
git config user.email >/dev/null 2>&1 || git config user.email "test@example.com"
git merge --no-ff 650dba4 -m "Merge 'Move to Stanford' changes into master

Brings in the previously-lost commit 650dba4 (about bio and layout updates).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>"
echo "--- merge exit: $? ---"
git status
EOF

cd /workspace/personal-site
# Resolve in favor of the recovered Stanford changes
git checkout --theirs -- _includes/about.md
git add _includes/about.md
echo "=== resolved about.md ==="
cat _includes/about.md
echo
echo "=== verify matches recovered commit ==="
git diff --quiet 650dba4 -- _includes/about.md && echo "about.md identical to 650dba4"
git diff --quiet 650dba4 -- _layouts/default.html && echo "default.html identical to 650dba4"
echo "=== stage status ==="
git status --short

cd /workspace/personal-site
git commit --no-edit
echo "=== RESULT ==="
git status
echo "=== LOG GRAPH ==="
git log --oneline --decorate --graph -6
echo "=== MERGE COMMIT FILES ==="
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
echo "=== FINAL about.md ==="
cat _includes/about.md
echo
echo "=== recovered commit now reachable? ==="
git merge-base --is-ancestor 650dba4 HEAD && echo "YES: 650dba4 is an ancestor of master"
